diagnosis: The LangGraph state inspection endpoint retrieves graph checkpoint state directly using the unvalidated checkpoint_id path parameter. It authenticates current_user but does not verify that the execution thread or checkpoint metadata belongs to current_user.tenant_id. An attacker can enumerate checkpoint IDs to read execution state history, prompt scratchpads, and confidential tool variables from another tenant's agent run.
exploit_request:
GET /agent/graph/checkpoints/chk_fin_analysis_8819/state HTTP/1.1
Host: agents.enterprise-ai.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
